question: Who has been awarded the first-ever EASD Diabetes Global Impact Prize in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. V Mohan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Renowned Indian diabetologist **Dr. V Mohan** has been honored with the **first-ever EASD Diabetes Global Impact Prize** in **2025** (announced/presented during the **60th EASD Annual Meeting**).
 
• The award was conferred by the **European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD)** to recognize his exceptional global contributions to the field of **diabetes research** and clinical practice.
 
• **Dr. V Mohan** is the **Chairman** and **Chief Diabetologist** of **Dr. Mohan’s Diabetes Specialities Centre** located in **Chennai**, **Tamil Nadu**.
